title: Empty

content:
Update of the Empty module for Orac 2.0 (Organelle) with CPU usage monitoring, sends a bang to show back the infobar (useful after removing modules that hide it, like the oscilloscope for example), also shows beat/clock on the LED (flashes white), knob1 controls the metronome from the clock module (S2), and turning the encoder locks it so we can navigate by pressing keys only (ideal for performances, unlocks automatically).

#1 : copy empty_2-8.zop to /Patches
#2 : reload the Organelle (menu Storage -> Reload)
#3 : run “Install empty_2-8.zop”

will be installed into /media/orac/usermodules for saving time when selecting modules.

includes an "empty" preset with this empty module loaded on every slot.

to select the empty module, navigate to the modules root folder, select empty, you'll see nothing, scroll down one time and click to place it (sorry i can't fix this)

v2.8 : graphics almost done, Lock function added (encoder button) for live performances, infobar hidden (press the encoder to show it for 3sec), "empty" preset added.

v2.7 : Transport controls added on aux (start / stop+reset) and knob1 (metronome), hold aux to keep stopped for a moment, release to restart, experimental graphics in progress

v2.6 just relocated into /media/orac/usermodules for saving time when selecting a module (saves 1-2sec. each time)

v2.5 now installed into /media/orac/usermodules/utility so it automatically replaces the original one without overwriting it (sometimes it's the original one that shows up, to avoid this you'll need place the new one into /Patches/orac/modules/utility to overwrite it)

v2.4 : shows beat/clock feedback on LED, knob1 controls the metronome volume of the clockswingx module, minor UI improvement
